instruction: Run `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\active_filter.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\active_filter.out`, `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\active_filter_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\active_filter.dat`. The native run contains one baseline case and six single-parameter `+1%` perturbation cases. From those 1 kHz gain measurements, write `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\sens.csv` with header `Component,Sensitivity,Relative` and list all six perturbed components sorted by descending `|Relative|`. [Software] Launch OrCAD Capture with `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\capture.exe` (adjust to your Cadence install root).
